what: Four-rung Stockfish anchor ladder on the campaign_v7 arch-v2 net (cycle 108, PIENNQ02 h1024) at blend 75 -- the FIRST anchor measurement of any arch-v2 net. Rungs 2400/2700/3000 as one ladder plus 3190 (Stockfish's UCI_Elo ceiling) as a second, 100 games per rung, 60+0.5s, Threads=1.
why: Every prior ladder number (1892 / 2146 / 2422 / S6 +83) used the v1 h64 net at blend 25. The 2026-08-15 paired A/B measured the new net at +160 Elo internally; this run tests how much of that transfers against an external opponent, and probes the top of the anchor scale.
anchor: official SF16 avx2 release, sha256 8f60a016dc767e0d648a8665b8ede3e6e4d28c086ad90517ad26f55b9960bd84, /workspace/stockfish16, sha re-verified at launch. UCI_LimitStrength=true, UCI_Elo per rung. Binary advertises UCI_Elo min 1320 max 3190 -- 3190 IS the ceiling; higher values are impossible (the arena refuses silently-clamped rungs, uci_elo_arena.py:652-664).

engine.search: S6-era, unchanged from the binary that measured 2146 on 2026-08-12

findings: RUNG-DEPENDENCE PERSISTS BUT FLATTENS AT THE TOP. Implied ratings climb 2511 -> 2611 -> 2759 -> 2798. The 2400->2700 step moves the estimate 100 Elo and 2700->3000 moves it 148, but 3000->3190 moves it only 39. SF16's UCI_Elo is badly compressed at the low end and behaves much more like a real scale from 3000 up. The high rungs are therefore the trustworthy instrument; recommend 3000/3190 as the canonical set going forward.

ZERO WINS AT 3190 IN 100 GAMES (0-19-81). Every point at the ceiling is a draw. The engine can hold SF16 at max limited strength about a fifth of the time but never beats it -- a qualitatively different regime from rung 2400 where it wins 46 outright.

THE +160 INTERNAL GAIN DID NOT TRANSFER INTACT. Projections from the 150 ms paired A/B predicted 67.3 / 45.6 / 25.4 / 16.2 percent at the four rungs; actuals were 65.5 / 37.5 / 20.0 / 9.5. The shortfall grows with opponent strength (-1.8, -8.1, -5.4, -6.7 points). Self-play-measured Elo overstates external gains, and more so against stronger opposition.
caveats: RAN UNDER CAMPAIGN LOAD, not the idle box the 2026-08-12 protocol used. Absolute values are provisional; the cross-rung comparison is the solid part since all four ran simultaneously under identical conditions.
MEASURES cycle-108, which the campaign superseded with cycle-118 (accepted 2026-08-15) partway through the run. These numbers are a floor for current strength, already one promotion stale.

Do NOT compare to the 2026-08-08 baseline of 1892 (rungs 1500/1800) or the 2026-08-12 figures of 2146/2422 (rungs 1800/2100 and 2400/2700). Different rung sets are different scales. The only clean engine-to-engine comparison at matched rungs here is 2400/2700: the old config scored 45%/25%, this one scores 65.5%/37.5%.
goal_note: The mission target of '~2700 on the pinned SF16 anchor scale' remains ambiguous: this same engine reads 2511 at rung 2400 and 2798 at rung 3190. Recommend redefining the target against a fixed rung set (suggest 3000/3190) before it drives any decision.
